Kho]] | blank1_name = Political party | blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Lakas-CMD}}|border=darkgray}} [[Lakas–CMD|Lakas]] | blank2_name = Congressional bloc | blank2_info = Majority }} '''Masbate's 1st congressional district''' is one of the three [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Masbate]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 15, 2021}} The district consists of six municipalities in the [[Burias (island)|Burias]] and [[Ticao Island|Ticao]] islands of northern Masbate, namely: [[Claveria, Masbate|Claveria]] and [[San Pascual, Masbate|San Pascual]] in Burias island and [[Batuan, Masbate|Batuan]], [[Monreal, Masbate|Monreal]], [[San Fernando, Masbate|San Fernando]] and [[San Jacinto, Masbate|San Jacinto]] in Ticao island.{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 15, 2021}} It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Antonio Kho (politician)|Antonio T. Kho]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]].{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 15, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
